svg.title: DR-MPC: Fast and Feasible Dynamics-Relaxed Model-Predictive Control for Legged Locomotion
svg.desc: Relax dynamics and affine friction residuals into penalties; eliminate swing forces and block stance controls; solve a reduced BoxQP. Contact-aware parameterization reduces the solver's factorized control system. Motion illustrates algorithm steps or system behavior; it does not reproduce reported numerical results.
